en.answer: They do not. These effects will only be applied to monsters in your Monster Zone, and not to monsters that are treated as Spell Cards.
en.question: Do the "● 5 or more:" and "● 8 or more:" effects of <<11746>> apply to Pendulum Monsters in my Pendulum Zone, or monsters that have become Equip Cards on my side of the field?

ja.answer:
適用されません。
